description.value: Freshii is a fast-casual health-food chain serving salads, wraps, burritos, poke bowls, energii bowls, and smoothies. The Abbotsford location sits at 1878 McCallum Road in a unit-format retail setting. Touring cyclists looking for a quick, nutrition-focused meal stop would find a familiar menu offering.
